title: The action teacher is strong, but predicted states lose useful task information
decision: Stop deeper teacher-lookahead recovery and test matched causal-context and learning-rate controls for transition fidelity.
plain_summary: Across three checkpoints, teacher and student action rankings are near 90 percent accurate, but task-value information falls sharply after prediction; the first dynamics-screen launch was infrastructure-invalid and a short-path v2 awaits safe admission.
